senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; v. אינש) [being], man.—Pl. (of אִישׁ) אֲנָשִׁים, const. אַנְשֵׁי.
units: Ex. R. s. 25; a. fr.—א׳ כנסת הגדולה (abbr. אכה״ג) the Men. of the Great Assembly, Synagoga Magna, a religious and judicial authority said to have been established by Ezra.

<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 1:1">Aboth I, 1</cite>; a. fr.; cmp. <cite ref="K00865"><he>כְּנֶסֶת</he></cite>.—(<he>ות</he>) <he>א׳ בית אב</he> the division on duty of priests having charge of the services of the day; <he>א׳ משמר</he> the division of priests alternately on duty during one week; <he>א׳ מעמד</he> the division (of Israelites) assisting the priests on duty, by prayers &c. on the platform (<cite ref="M02143"><he>מעמד</he></cite>) and divided in parties corresponding to the priestly divisions.
<cite ref="Mishnah Taanit 2:6">Taan. II, 6</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Taanit 2:7">7</cite>; a. fr.
